title: pq snapshot pause
text:
# `pq snapshot pause`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Pauses a snapshot.

## Usage
```
pq snapshot pause <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--wait` | Block until the operation is completed on all nodes. |
| `--include-internal` | Also show internal system objects (names starting with `__`). |
| `--force` | Skip the confirmation prompt. |

## Example
```
pq snapshot pause orders --wait
```

title: PQ-E4157 REPLICATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED
text:
# PQ-E4157 REPLICATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `replicator: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the replicator is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `replicator.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

title: compactor.timeout_ms
text:
# `compactor.timeout_ms`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Time in milliseconds that the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages waits for a response before the operation fails.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `5000` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | compactor |
| Unit | ms |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `compactor.timeout_ms` only if you observe problems with the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[compactor]
timeout_ms = 5000
```

title: Postmortem INC-2024-158
text:
# Postmortem INC-2024-158: fraud-scoring degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 90 minutes
**Impact:** Duplicate processing in `fraud-scoring`

## Summary
During the incident, `fraud-scoring` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E1915 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `fraud-scoring` fired.
- T+22: On-call engineer found PQ-E1915 in the broker logs.
- T+45: The team rolled back the last client deployment.
- T+90: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a failing disk on one node.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E1915.
- Add an alert for this error code.

text:
# `spool.interval_s`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `300` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | spool |
| Unit | s |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Notes

Changes to `spool.interval_s` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[spool]
interval_s = 300
```

title: PQ-E4426 SCHEDULER_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED
text:
# PQ-E4426 SCHEDULER_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The scheduler gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `scheduler.max_retries`.

title: PQ-E1176 INGRESS_WORK_QUEUE_FULL
text:
# PQ-E1176 INGRESS_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `ingress: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.1

## What it means
The internal work queue of the ingress is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A slow disk
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `ingress.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

text:
# Runbook: retention troubleshooting

> Operations runbook

This runbook covers the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.

## Health check
1. Run `pq node describe <node> --output json` and check the `retention` section.
2. Look at the `paderqueue_retention_errors_total` metric.

## Relevant settings
- `retention.log_level`
- `retention.threshold_percent`
- `retention.batch_size`
- `retention.interval_s`
- `retention.worker_threads`
- `retention.timeout_ms`
- `retention.queue_capacity`
- `retention.max_connections`

## Escalation
If the problem persists for more than 30 minutes, escalate to the platform team.

title: PQ-E4007 BROKER_CODEC_MISMATCH
text:
# PQ-E4007 BROKER_CODEC_MISMATCH

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `broker: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
Two nodes of the broker use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Set `broker.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

title: PQ-E4964 DLQ_CODEC_MISMATCH
text:
# PQ-E4964 DLQ_CODEC_MISMATCH

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `dlq: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 1.0

## What it means
Two nodes of the dlq use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Set `dlq.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

title: PQ-E2273 COORDINATOR_COMPONENT_DISABLED
text:
# PQ-E2273 COORDINATOR_COMPONENT_DISABLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `coordinator: component disabled`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 1.2

## What it means
A request needed the coordinator, but the coordinator is switched off.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Enable the component by setting `coordinator.enabled` to `true` and restart the node.

title: coordinator.compression
text:
# `coordinator.compression`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Compression codec that the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers uses for stored or transferred data.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | enum: none | lz4 | zstd |
| Default | `none` |
| Available since | 2.0 |
| Component | coordinator |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `coordinator.compression` only if you observe problems with the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[coordinator]
compression = "none"
```

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: throttled`
**Severity:** error

The scheduler is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

title: PQ-E3108 SPOOL_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED
text:
# PQ-E3108 SPOOL_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `spool: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.1

## What it means
The spool refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `spool.max_connections`.

text:
# PQ-E1441 COORDINATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `coordinator: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
Two nodes of the coordinator use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Set `coordinator.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

title: PaderQueue 2.0 release notes
text:
# PaderQueue 2.0 release notes

Released on 2022-04-11.

This is a major release. Read the section on changed defaults before upgrading.

## New features

- New option `compactor.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.
- New option `partitioner.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written, in bytes.
- New error code PQ-E2051 (COMPACTOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New option `acktracker.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.
- New option `spool.compression`: compression codec that the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments uses for stored or transferred data.
- New error code PQ-E3575 (COORDINATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4426 (SCHEDULER_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4708 (SCHEDULER_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `coordinator.compression`: compression codec that the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers uses for stored or transferred data.
- New option `dlq.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue.
- New option `snapshotter.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.
- New error code PQ-E3321 (REPLICATOR_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `retention.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.
- New option `scheduler.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time starts throttling.
- New error code PQ-E1451 (INGRESS_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New option `snapshotter.batch_size`: number of messages the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues processes together in one batch.
- New error code PQ-E4895 (REPLICATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New option `retention.batch_size`: number of messages the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period processes together in one batch.
- New error code PQ-E3682 (REPLICATOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2187 (PARTITIONER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4030 (AUTH_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `compactor.compression`: compression codec that the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages uses for stored or transferred data.

## Bug fixes and improvements

- Fixed a crash of the spool when the configuration file contained trailing whitespace.

# PQ-E3682 REPLICATOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `replicator: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the replicator is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `replicator.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `30` |

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
interval_s = 30
```

# Postmortem INC-2024-171: search-indexer degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 90 minutes
**Impact:** Failed requests in `search-indexer`

## Summary
During the incident, `search-indexer` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E1915 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `search-indexer` fired.
- T+22: On-call engineer found PQ-E1915 in the broker logs.
- T+45: The team rolled back the last client deployment.
- T+90: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a marketing campaign that tripled traffic.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E1915.
- Add an alert for this error code.

title: PQ-E4712 SNAPSHOTTER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL
text:
# PQ-E4712 SNAPSHOTTER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `snapshotter: work queue full`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 1.2

## What it means
The internal work queue of the snapshotter is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `snapshotter.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**First introduced in:** 2.0

The in-memory buffer of the partitioner is full and new data is rejected.

- A consumer that stopped reading

Reduce the incoming rate or increase `partitioner.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

title: pq token describe
text:
# `pq token describe`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Describes a token.

## Usage
```
pq token describe <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--label` | Attach a `key=value` label. Can be repeated. |
| `--force` | Skip the confirmation prompt. |
| `--retain-days` | Number of days the result is kept before it is deleted automatically. |
| `--priority` | Priority from 0 (lowest) to 9 (highest). Default: 4. |

## Example
```
pq token describe orders --label
```

# `retention.threshold_percent` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `90` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | retention |
| Unit | % |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `retention.threshold_percent` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[retention]
threshold_percent = 90
```

title: PQ-E3891 COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL
text:
# PQ-E3891 COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `compactor: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the compactor is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `compactor.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

title: PQ-E1425 PARTITIONER_CODEC_MISMATCH
text:
# PQ-E1425 PARTITIONER_CODEC_MISMATCH

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `partitioner: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
Two nodes of the partitioner use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Set `partitioner.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

Size of the in-memory buffer used by the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics, in bytes.

title: PQ-E4934 SPOOL_THROTTLED
text:
# PQ-E4934 SPOOL_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `spool: throttled`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 1.0

## What it means
The spool is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `spool.threshold_percent`.

title: PQ-E4371 ACKTRACKER_COMPONENT_DISABLED
text:
# PQ-E4371 ACKTRACKER_COMPONENT_DISABLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `acktracker: component disabled`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.2

## What it means
A request needed the acktracker, but the acktracker is switched off.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Enable the component by setting `acktracker.enabled` to `true` and restart the node.

| Default | `10000` |
| Available since | 1.1 |

| Unit | ms |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `dlq.timeout_ms` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml

```

title: PaderQueue 3.0 release notes
text:
# PaderQueue 3.0 release notes

Released on 2023-09-18.

This is a major release. Read the section on changed defaults before upgrading.

## Changed defaults

- **Changed default:** `partitioner.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `16777216` (previously `1048576`).
- **Changed default:** `auth.interval_s` now defaults to `300` (previously `10`).
- **Changed default:** `retention.worker_threads` now defaults to `2` (previously `1`).
- **Changed default:** `metrics.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `4194304` (previously `1048576`).
- **Changed default:** `replicator.worker_threads` now defaults to `1` (previously `2`).
- **Changed default:** `spool.compression` now defaults to `lz4` (previously `zstd`).
- **Changed default:** `quota.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `33554432` (previously `4194304`).
- **Changed default:** `metrics.batch_size` now defaults to `256` (previously `32`).
- **Changed default:** `spool.threshold_percent` now defaults to `95` (previously `90`).
- **Changed default:** `retention.threshold_percent` now defaults to `95` (previously `90`).
- **Changed default:** `ingress.timeout_ms` now defaults to `500` (previously `2000`).
- **Changed default:** `quota.batch_size` now defaults to `256` (previously `500`).
- **Changed default:** `broker.compression` now defaults to `zstd` (previously `lz4`).
- **Changed default:** `compactor.compression` now defaults to `lz4` (previously `none`).
- **Changed default:** `spool.max_connections` now defaults to `1024` (previously `128`).
- **Changed default:** `retention.timeout_ms` now defaults to `2000` (previously `10000`).
- **Changed default:** `dlq.batch_size` now defaults to `256` (previously `100`).
- **Changed default:** `snapshotter.threshold_percent` now defaults to `80` (previously `75`).
- **Changed default:** `ingress.interval_s` now defaults to `5` (previously `300`).
- **Changed default:** `snapshotter.max_connections` now defaults to `512` (previously `256`).
- **Changed default:** `metrics.interval_s` now defaults to `10` (previously `300`).
- **Changed default:** `scheduler.log_level` now defaults to `info` (previously `error`).

## New features

- New option `retention.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.
- New option `ingress.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST starts throttling.
- New error code PQ-E1441 (COORDINATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4572 (QUOTA_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `broker.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues, in bytes.
- New option `metrics.log_level`: log verbosity of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.
- New option `acktracker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.
- New option `quota.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.
- New error code PQ-E4007 (BROKER_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2154 (QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3891 (COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `replicator.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New error code PQ-E2758 (RETENTION_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2995 (QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1563 (SNAPSHOTTER_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `metrics.compression`: compression codec that the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics uses for stored or transferred data.
- New option `ingress.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST, in bytes.
- New option `scheduler.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time before an operation is reported as failed.
- New option `spool.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments before an operation is reported as failed.
- New error code PQ-E2613 (PARTITIONER_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3642 (ACKTRACKER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1584 (DLQ_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.

## Bug fixes and improvements

- The metrics now logs its effective configuration at startup.
- Fixed a memory leak in the auth under high load.
- Fixed wrong metric labels reported by the compactor.
- Improved startup time of the snapshotter.
- Fixed a memory leak in the metrics under high load.
- Fixed a memory leak in the quota under high load.
- The replicator now logs its effective configuration at startup.

# Runbook: replicator troubleshooting

> Operations runbook

This runbook covers the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

## Health check
1. Run `pq node describe <node> --output json` and check the `replicator` section.
2. Look at the `paderqueue_replicator_errors_total` metric.

## Relevant settings
- `replicator.buffer_bytes`
- `replicator.interval_s`
- `replicator.queue_capacity`
- `replicator.enabled`
- `replicator.worker_threads`
- `replicator.timeout_ms`
- `replicator.max_connections`
- `replicator.compression`

## Escalation
If the problem persists for more than 30 minutes, escalate to the platform team.

title: PQ-E4030 AUTH_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED
text:
# PQ-E4030 AUTH_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `auth: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The auth refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `auth.max_connections`.

# PQ-E4663 COORDINATOR_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `coordinator: throttled`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 1.1

## What it means
The coordinator is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `coordinator.threshold_percent`.

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `spool: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 1.2

Two nodes of the spool use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

Set `spool.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

title: PaderQueue 1.1 release notes
text:
# PaderQueue 1.1 release notes

Released on 2021-07-19.

## New features

- New option `scheduler.batch_size`: number of messages the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time processes together in one batch.
- New option `metrics.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.
- New option `snapshotter.enabled`: turns the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues on or off.
- New option `auth.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the authentication module that validates client tokens waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New option `dlq.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New option `partitioner.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.
- New error code PQ-E1616 (PARTITIONER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `replicator.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.
- New option `retention.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling.
- New error code PQ-E1547 (PARTITIONER_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `partitioner.enabled`: turns the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written on or off.
- New option `scheduler.log_level`: log verbosity of the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.
- New option `quota.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant, in bytes.
- New error code PQ-E4798 (SCHEDULER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `acktracker.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New option `snapshotter.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.
- New error code PQ-E4663 (COORDINATOR_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `auth.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the authentication module that validates client tokens.
- New option `broker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues.
- New error code PQ-E3805 (DLQ_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2547 (COMPACTOR_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

## Bug fixes and improvements

- Fixed a memory leak in the partitioner under high load.
- Fixed a memory leak in the broker under high load.
- Fixed a memory leak in the broker under high load.
- Improved startup time of the coordinator.

- A deployment where nodes have different settings

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `metrics: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.2

Two nodes of the metrics use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

- A long garbage collection pause
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Set `metrics.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

title: PaderQueue 3.1 release notes
text:
# PaderQueue 3.1 release notes

Released on 2024-01-15.

## New features

- New option `acktracker.batch_size`: number of messages the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed processes together in one batch.
- New error code PQ-E1176 (INGRESS_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `coordinator.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers.
- New option `spool.log_level`: log verbosity of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.
- New option `compactor.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.
- New option `broker.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues starts throttling.
- New option `coordinator.enabled`: turns the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers on or off.
- New option `compactor.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.
- New option `dlq.enabled`: turns the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue on or off.
- New option `compactor.batch_size`: number of messages the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages processes together in one batch.
- New error code PQ-E3249 (ACKTRACKER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `acktracker.enabled`: turns the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed on or off.
- New error code PQ-E3841 (REPLICATOR_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1405 (BROKER_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `scheduler.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.
- New option `metrics.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics starts throttling.

## Bug fixes and improvements

- Fixed a race condition in the partitioner during node shutdown.
- Fixed a crash of the ingress when the configuration file contained trailing whitespace.
- The compactor now logs its effective configuration at startup.
- Fixed a race condition in the scheduler during node shutdown.
- The snapshotter now logs its effective configuration at startup.
- Improved startup time of the scheduler.

text:
# Runbook: partitioner troubleshooting

> Operations runbook

This runbook covers the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.

## Health check
1. Run `pq node describe <node> --output json` and check the `partitioner` section.
2. Look at the `paderqueue_partitioner_errors_total` metric.

## Relevant settings
- `partitioner.buffer_bytes`
- `partitioner.batch_size`
- `partitioner.queue_capacity`
- `partitioner.max_retries`
- `partitioner.compression`
- `partitioner.interval_s`
- `partitioner.enabled`

title: PaderQueue 2.3 release notes
text:
# PaderQueue 2.3 release notes

Released on 2023-03-27.

## New features

- New option `scheduler.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time, in bytes.
- New error code PQ-E4540 (METRICS_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1163 (SNAPSHOTTER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `auth.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the authentication module that validates client tokens starts throttling.
- New option `partitioner.log_level`: log verbosity of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.
- New option `quota.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New error code PQ-E4157 (REPLICATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `dlq.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue before an operation is reported as failed.
- New error code PQ-E3788 (COMPACTOR_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2771 (DLQ_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1736 (BROKER_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `dlq.batch_size`: number of messages the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue processes together in one batch.
- New option `auth.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the authentication module that validates client tokens before an operation is reported as failed.
- New option `partitioner.batch_size`: number of messages the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written processes together in one batch.
- New option `snapshotter.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues before an operation is reported as failed.
- New option `ingress.compression`: compression codec that the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST uses for stored or transferred data.
- New error code PQ-E2602 (COORDINATOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1425 (PARTITIONER_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1783 (AUTH_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3397 (METRICS_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `snapshotter.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues, in bytes.
- New error code PQ-E3246 (SCHEDULER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `dlq.compression`: compression codec that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue uses for stored or transferred data.
- New option `ingress.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST.
- New option `partitioner.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.

## Bug fixes and improvements

- Fixed a crash of the retention when the configuration file contained trailing whitespace.
- The coordinator now logs its effective configuration at startup.
- Improved startup time of the compactor.
- Improved startup time of the coordinator.
- Fixed wrong metric labels reported by the scheduler.
- Fixed wrong metric labels reported by the ingress.
- The metrics now logs its effective configuration at startup.
- Fixed a crash of the dlq when the configuration file contained trailing whitespace.
- The compactor now logs its effective configuration at startup.

title: PQ-E4895 REPLICATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH
text:
# PQ-E4895 REPLICATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `replicator: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
Two nodes of the replicator use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Set `replicator.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

title: PQ-E1163 SNAPSHOTTER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED
text:
# PQ-E1163 SNAPSHOTTER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `snapshotter: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The snapshotter refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A slow disk
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `snapshotter.max_connections`.

title: PaderQueue 2.2 release notes
text:
# PaderQueue 2.2 release notes

Released on 2022-12-12.

## New features

- New option `broker.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New option `acktracker.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.
- New error code PQ-E4371 (ACKTRACKER_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4711 (ACKTRACKER_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New option `snapshotter.log_level`: log verbosity of the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.
- New error code PQ-E3828 (METRICS_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3239 (QUOTA_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `coordinator.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers starts throttling.
- New option `coordinator.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers.
- New option `dlq.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue.
- New option `metrics.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics before an operation is reported as failed.
- New option `quota.batch_size`: number of messages the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant processes together in one batch.
- New option `replicator.compression`: compression codec that the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes uses for stored or transferred data.
- New option `compactor.enabled`: turns the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages on or off.
- New error code PQ-E1944 (RETENTION_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `spool.enabled`: turns the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments on or off.
- New option `replicator.enabled`: turns the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes on or off.
- New error code PQ-E1915 (METRICS_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `ingress.batch_size`: number of messages the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST processes together in one batch.
- New option `dlq.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue starts throttling.
- New error code PQ-E3441 (ACKTRACKER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `ingress.log_level`: log verbosity of the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST.

## Bug fixes and improvements

- Fixed a race condition in the ingress during node shutdown.
- Fixed wrong metric labels reported by the coordinator.
- Improved startup time of the auth.
- Fixed a race condition in the compactor during node shutdown.

text:
# PaderQueue 4.0 release notes

Released on 2025-02-10.

This is a major release. Read the section on changed defaults before upgrading.

## Changed defaults

- **Changed default:** `dlq.threshold_percent` now defaults to `70` (previously `90`).
- **Changed default:** `dlq.max_retries` now defaults to `3` (previously `8`).
- **Changed default:** `coordinator.queue_capacity` now defaults to `100` (previously `5000`).
- **Changed default:** `compactor.log_level` now defaults to `warn` (previously `info`).
- **Changed default:** `quota.worker_threads` now defaults to `4` (previously `8`).
- **Changed default:** `broker.timeout_ms` now defaults to `10000` (previously `2000`).
- **Changed default:** `partitioner.max_retries` now defaults to `3` (previously `10`).
- **Changed default:** `coordinator.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `67108864` (previously `4194304`).
- **Changed default:** `spool.interval_s` now defaults to `300` (previously `60`).
- **Changed default:** `metrics.max_retries` now defaults to `20` (previously `8`).
- **Changed default:** `snapshotter.batch_size` now defaults to `64` (previously `100`).
- **Changed default:** `spool.max_retries` now defaults to `10` (previously `12`).
- **Changed default:** `partitioner.queue_capacity` now defaults to `100` (previously `1000`).
- **Changed default:** `retention.log_level` now defaults to `error` (previously `warn`).
- **Changed default:** `dlq.worker_threads` now defaults to `1` (previously `8`).
- **Changed default:** `scheduler.batch_size` now defaults to `500` (previously `100`).
- **Changed default:** `snapshotter.queue_capacity` now defaults to `10000` (previously `1000`).
- **Changed default:** `replicator.max_connections` now defaults to `4096` (previously `1024`).
- **Changed default:** `retention.batch_size` now defaults to `256` (previously `32`).
- **Changed default:** `acktracker.batch_size` now defaults to `100` (previously `256`).
- **Changed default:** `coordinator.batch_size` now defaults to `64` (previously `500`).
- **Changed default:** `compactor.worker_threads` now defaults to `2` (previously `8`).
- **Changed default:** `snapshotter.max_retries` now defaults to `10` (previously `8`).
- **Changed default:** `broker.buffer_bytes` now defaults to `4194304` (previously `33554432`).
- **Changed default:** `dlq.timeout_ms` now defaults to `10000` (previously `30000`).
- **Changed default:** `auth.worker_threads` now defaults to `8` (previously `2`).
- **Changed default:** `partitioner.compression` now defaults to `none` (previously `lz4`).
- **Changed default:** `auth.max_retries` now defaults to `3` (previously `20`).

## Bug fixes and improvements

- Fixed wrong metric labels reported by the spool.
- Fixed a race condition in the spool during node shutdown.
- The auth now logs its effective configuration at startup.
- Fixed a crash of the coordinator when the configuration file contained trailing whitespace.
- Fixed a race condition in the snapshotter during node shutdown.
- Improved startup time of the partitioner.
- Fixed a crash of the replicator when the configuration file contained trailing whitespace.
- Fixed a memory leak in the acktracker under high load.

- New option `metrics.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.
- New error code PQ-E3221 (BROKER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `broker.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues.
- New error code PQ-E4582 (RETENTION_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `retention.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.
- New error code PQ-E1019 (INGRESS_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2617 (DLQ_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `scheduler.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.
- New option `broker.compression`: compression codec that the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues uses for stored or transferred data.
- New error code PQ-E3557 (REPLICATOR_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `ingress.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST waits for a response before the operation fails.

## Bug fixes and improvements

- Fixed a memory leak in the broker under high load.
- Fixed a crash of the retention when the configuration file contained trailing whitespace.
- The acktracker now logs its effective configuration at startup.
- Fixed a crash of the spool when the configuration file contained trailing whitespace.
- Fixed a crash of the quota when the configuration file contained trailing whitespace.
- The retention now logs its effective configuration at startup.

title: PQ-E2051 COMPACTOR_CODEC_MISMATCH
text:
# PQ-E2051 COMPACTOR_CODEC_MISMATCH

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `compactor: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
Two nodes of the compactor use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

## Common causes
- A slow disk
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Set `compactor.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

# `acktracker.max_retries`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of retry attempts of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `20` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | acktracker |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `acktracker.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
max_retries = 20
```

title: PQ-E3321 REPLICATOR_COMPONENT_DISABLED
text:
# PQ-E3321 REPLICATOR_COMPONENT_DISABLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `replicator: component disabled`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
A request needed the replicator, but the replicator is switched off.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Enable the component by setting `replicator.enabled` to `true` and restart the node.

title: PQ-E1565 COORDINATOR_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED
text:
# PQ-E1565 COORDINATOR_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `coordinator: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 1.2

## What it means
The coordinator refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `coordinator.max_connections`.

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Exports a token.

pq token export <name> [flags]
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|

pq token export orders --priority
```

# `replicator.buffer_bytes`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Size of the in-memory buffer used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes, in bytes.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (bytes) |
| Default | `67108864` |
| Available since | 1.0 |
| Component | replicator |
| Unit | bytes |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `replicator.buffer_bytes` only if you observe problems with the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[replicator]
buffer_bytes = 67108864
```

title: PaderQueue 2.1 release notes
text:
# PaderQueue 2.1 release notes

Released on 2022-08-29.

## New features

- New option `auth.batch_size`: number of messages the authentication module that validates client tokens processes together in one batch.
- New option `compactor.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages waits for a response before the operation fails.
- New option `quota.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.
- New error code PQ-E3108 (SPOOL_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `auth.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the authentication module that validates client tokens.
- New option `ingress.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST.
- New option `metrics.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics, in bytes.
- New error code PQ-E4590 (SNAPSHOTTER_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `auth.log_level`: log verbosity of the authentication module that validates client tokens.
- New option `scheduler.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.
- New option `spool.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.
- New option `replicator.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.
- New option `acktracker.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed before an operation is reported as failed.
- New error code PQ-E1799 (RETENTION_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2425 (ACKTRACKER_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `broker.enabled`: turns the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues on or off.
- New option `broker.batch_size`: number of messages the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues processes together in one batch.
- New option `spool.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments starts throttling.
- New option `spool.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.
- New option `coordinator.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers.
- New error code PQ-E1779 (INGRESS_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1465 (INGRESS_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3114 (SPOOL_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

## Bug fixes and improvements

- Fixed a race condition in the ingress during node shutdown.
- Fixed wrong metric labels reported by the spool.
- Fixed a race condition in the auth during node shutdown.
- Fixed a crash of the auth when the configuration file contained trailing whitespace.
- Fixed a memory leak in the scheduler under high load.

title: PQ-E2995 QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED
text:
# PQ-E2995 QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `quota: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The quota gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `quota.max_retries`.

title: PQ-E3642 ACKTRACKER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL
text:
# PQ-E3642 ACKTRACKER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `acktracker: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
The internal work queue of the acktracker is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `acktracker.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

text:
# PQ-E1451 INGRESS_CODEC_MISMATCH

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `ingress: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
Two nodes of the ingress use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

## Common causes
- A slow disk
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix

title: PaderQueue 1.2 release notes
text:
# PaderQueue 1.2 release notes

Released on 2021-12-06.

## New features

- New option `retention.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.
- New error code PQ-E2137 (DLQ_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E2273 (COORDINATOR_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `auth.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the authentication module that validates client tokens.
- New error code PQ-E3859 (BROKER_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E4020 (SPOOL_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.
- New option `replicator.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.
- New error code PQ-E4013 (AUTH_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E3792 (AUTH_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.
- New error code PQ-E1565 (COORDINATOR_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.
- New option `compactor.log_level`: log verbosity of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.
- New option `quota.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.
- New option `quota.enabled`: turns the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant on or off.
- New option `spool.batch_size`: number of messages the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments processes together in one batch.
- New option `partitioner.compression`: compression codec that the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written uses for stored or transferred data.
- New option `snapshotter.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues starts throttling.
- New error code PQ-E4712 (SNAPSHOTTER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.
- New option `retention.log_level`: log verbosity of the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.
- New option `coordinator.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers, in bytes.
- New option `partitioner.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.
- New option `quota.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant before an operation is reported as failed.
- New option `coordinator.batch_size`: number of messages the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers processes together in one batch.
- New option `replicator.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

## Bug fixes and improvements

- Fixed a memory leak in the broker under high load.
- Fixed a crash of the coordinator when the configuration file contained trailing whitespace.
- Fixed a memory leak in the retention under high load.
- Fixed wrong metric labels reported by the acktracker.

title: PQ-E3788 COMPACTOR_OPERATION_TIMEOUT
text:
# PQ-E3788 COMPACTOR_OPERATION_TIMEOUT

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `compactor: operation timeout`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
An operation of the compactor did not complete within the configured timeout.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check network latency and load on the involved nodes. For slow but healthy clusters, increase `compactor.timeout_ms`.

title: quota.buffer_bytes (PaderQueue 2.x)
text:
# `quota.buffer_bytes` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Size of the in-memory buffer used by the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant, in bytes.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (bytes) |
| Default | `4194304` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | quota |
| Unit | bytes |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `quota.buffer_bytes` only if you observe problems with the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[quota]
buffer_bytes = 4194304
```

title: Postmortem INC-2024-212
text:
# Postmortem INC-2024-212: fraud-scoring degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 55 minutes
**Impact:** Delayed messages for `fraud-scoring`

## Summary
During the incident, `fraud-scoring` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4030 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `fraud-scoring` fired.
- T+13: On-call engineer found PQ-E4030 in the broker logs.
- T+27: The team restarted the affected nodes.
- T+55: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E4030.
- Add an alert for this error code.

title: pq snapshot describe
text:
# `pq snapshot describe`

> CLI reference, PaderQueue 4.x

Describes a snapshot.

## Usage
```
pq snapshot describe <name> [flags]
```

## Flags
| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--since` | Only consider objects created after this timestamp (ISO 8601). |
| `--wait` | Block until the operation is completed on all nodes. |
| `--include-internal` | Also show internal system objects (names starting with `__`). |
| `--tenant` | Name of the tenant the command applies to. |

## Example
```
pq snapshot describe orders --since
```

title: PQ-E3441 ACKTRACKER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED
text:
# PQ-E3441 ACKTRACKER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `acktracker: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.2

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the acktracker is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A slow disk
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `acktracker.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

title: PaderQueue 3.3 release notes
text:
# PaderQueue 3.3 release notes

Released on 2024-09-23.

## Bug fixes and improvements

- The auth now logs its effective configuration at startup.
- The retention now logs its effective configuration at startup.
- The ingress now logs its effective configuration at startup.
- Fixed a memory leak in the partitioner under high load.
- Fixed a crash of the broker when the configuration file contained trailing whitespace.
- The ingress now logs its effective configuration at startup.
